title: Rory and the Sleepy Clover Cove
verses:
The stars were beginning to twinkle and gleam,
While Rory was ready to drift in a dream.
He walked through the valley of clover so sweet,
And felt the soft moss underneath his big feet.

Then Tilly arrived with a slow, sleepy sigh,
And looked at the moon in the deep velvet sky.
Then Benny lay down on the cool, grassy floor,
And started to let out a very soft snore.

Now Ricky was tired of running around,
He curled in a circle and slept on the ground.
And Nia flew down from her perch in the tree,
As cozy and quiet as quiet could be.

Psittaco chirped as he looked at the night,
And watched as the stars were beginning to light.
He nestled right close to his big dino friend,
And knew that the day had come near to its end.

The clover was fragrant, the night air was still,
As moonlight was shining on valley and hill.
And Rory was happy to snuggle so deep,
With all of his buddies preparing to sleep.

The forest was breathing a soft, sleepy tune,
Beneath the bright glow of the silver-white moon.
So close your eyes now as the little stars gleam,
While Rory is drifting in one happy dream.
